```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk_set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Executive Summary

This R Markdown document synthesizes sales transaction logs (reusing Day 09 generator logic) into an automated report.

```{r data_generation}
# Generate sales dataset inline
set.seed(42)
n_records <- 150

sales_df <- data.frame(
  OrderID = 1000 + 1:n_records,
  Region = sample(c("North", "East", "South", "West"), n_records, replace = TRUE),
  Category = sample(c("Electronics", "Furniture", "Office Supplies", "Clothing"), n_records, replace = TRUE),
  Quantity = sample(1:10, n_records, replace = TRUE),
  Price = round(runif(n_records, 15.00, 250.00), 2),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(Revenue = Price * Quantity)
```

## Financial Metrics Summary Table

```{r metrics_table}
summary_table <- sales_df %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Orders = n(),
    Total_Units = sum(Quantity),
    Average_Order_Value = round(mean(Revenue), 2),
    Gross_Revenue = round(sum(Revenue), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(summary_table, caption = "Regional Sales Breakdown")
```

## Performance Charts

### 1. Revenue Distribution by Region

```{r chart1, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
ggplot(sales_df, aes(x = Region, y = Revenue, fill = Region)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Revenue Variance across Geographic Regions", y = "Revenue ($)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 2. Category Performance Comparison

```{r chart2, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
ggplot(sales_df, aes(x = Category, y = Revenue, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Gross Revenue per Product Category", y = "Revenue ($)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 3. Unit Sales Volume

```{r chart3, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
ggplot(sales_df, aes(x = Quantity, fill = Category)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Order Quantity Histogram", x = "Units per Order") +
  theme_minimal()
```
